rubrics.justification: Accurately describes a good-quality expanded/full blastocyst with thinned zona, compact ICM, and cohesive TE, and appropriately notes limits of single-image assessment; minor uncertainty around exact 3 vs 4 expansion stage prevents a perfect score.
Comprehensively integrates age, BMI, endometriosis, ovarian reserve, prior biochemical pregnancy, sperm quality, endometrial thickness, and oocyte maturity with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and well structured, with conclusions generally supported by morphology and clinical context; slight tension remains around the day-4 versus blastocyst-stage inconsistency and how heavily it affects the estimate.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with Gardner grading, SET preference, caution with add-ons, and selective PGT-A use; minor speculative elements around transfer timing/staging keep it from full marks.

Provides clear, practical next steps for the current transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, lifestyle guidance, endometriosis/adenomyosis review, FET considerations, and escalation only after repeated failures.
